Dear applicant,

We are pleased to inform you that you have been admitted to the Master's programme Informatics for the winter semester 2027/28. Please accept your study place in TUMonline by 15 July 2027.

Zulassungsbescheid

Sie wurden zum Masterstudiengang Physik zum Wintersemester 2027/28 zugelassen. Bitte schreiben Sie sich bis zum 30. September 2027 ein.

Dear applicant,

Thank you for your application to the Master's programme in Machine Learning. After careful review we regret to inform you that we are unable to offer you a place this year.

Antagningsbesked

Masterprogram i datavetenskap, Uppsala universitet: Du är reserv (reservnummer 14). Du meddelas om en plats blir ledig.

Dear applicant,

The selection committee has placed you on our ranking list at position 7 for the MSc Data Science. Should a place become available, we will contact you before 1 August.

Dear applicant,

We are delighted to make you a conditional offer of a place on the MSc Artificial Intelligence. Your offer is subject to: a final degree transcript showing a 2:1 or equivalent; an IELTS Academic score of 7.0 overall.
Sie sind unter Vorbehalt zum Master Wirtschaftsinformatik zugelassen. Die Zulassung wird wirksam, wenn Sie bis zum 31. August 2027 Ihr Bachelorzeugnis nachreichen.

Dear applicant,

We are happy to inform you that you have been admitted to the M.Sc. Business Informatics. Unfortunately, we are unable to award you the Mannheim Master Scholarship this year.
Grattis! Du är antagen till masterprogrammet i nationalekonomi och har tilldelats Lund University Global Scholarship som täcker hela studieavgiften.

Dear applicant,

We are unable to offer you a place in the MSc Data Science. However, the admissions committee would like to offer you a place in the MSc Statistics instead. Please reply within two weeks if you wish to accept this alternative offer.
Für den Master Informatik können wir Ihnen leider keinen Platz anbieten. Wir bieten Ihnen stattdessen einen Studienplatz im Master Wirtschaftsinformatik an.

Dear applicant, a decision has been made on your graduate application. Please log in to the applicant self-service portal to view your decision letter.

der Auswahlausschuss hat Ihnen ein DAAD-Studienstipendium für ein Masterstudium in Deutschland ab dem 1. Oktober 2027 bewilligt.
